name: Metadata Ownership Tracking
description: Monitor and manage metadata ownership across orgs with static resources

initialMessages.content: I want to build a metadata ownership tracking app on Salesforce. It should let teams register ownership of metadata components — Apex classes, flows, custom objects, LWCs — with fields for owner, team, last reviewed date, and status (Active/Deprecated/Under Review). I need a dashboard that shows unowned metadata, stale ownership (not reviewed in 90+ days), and ownership distribution by team. Include bulk import so we can seed it from a CSV.

I'll build that for you. The project has a React frontend and Salesforce metadata scaffolding ready to go. I'll start with the ownership data model and registry, then add the staleness tracking and dashboard views. Here goes!
